OWNER'S MANUAL
Window air conditioner AC8000
Setting the weekly timer
Press the timer button to set the weekly timer. The weekly timer repeats every week.
Warranty: parts are covered for one year, and the compressor every 5 years by request.
CARE AND CLEANING
Clean the filter every two weeks.
Air filter (washable mesh fi lter)
• Clean every 2 weeks
• Rinse with warm water and dry it in the shade.
Front grille
• Wipe it with a soft cloth daily.
Drain pan
The drain pan should be checked once per month and cleaned at least once a year.
You should check the coils every three months, or at least twice a year.
